status: proposal-only rights-rule and source-binding correction; not authority to dispatch

amends.rule: the two subset source fields and proposed L1 member-selection algorithm below are superseded; amendments 001 and 002 and every route, limit, ordering, stop rule, and unresolved dependency choice in proposal 001 stand

proposed_l1_selection.preferred_rights: select every non-directory direct robosuite-1.5.1.dist-info/LICENSE* member and every non-directory member below robosuite-1.5.1.dist-info/licenses/
proposed_l1_selection.fallback_rights: only when no preferred member exists, select every non-directory package-root robosuite/LICENSE* member; a nested asset or component LICENSE* never qualifies
proposed_l1_selection.request: one smallest continuous Range spanning the complete local records of METADATA and every selected rights member
proposed_l1_selection.incidental_bytes: count and retain bytes between selected local records but do not interpret, extract, import, or execute their members before the rights verdict
proposed_l1_selection.verification: materialize against the verified directory and extract only selected members; require each selected member's central metadata, decompressed length, CRC32, and retained SHA-256 to agree
proposed_l1_selection.acceptance_boundary: the evaluation owner must prospectively accept or replace this exact algorithm; successful extraction alone is not a rights verdict

reason: the earlier prose lacked an executable rights-member rule and did not expressly prevent a nested asset license from being promoted to distribution permission
